gloss: to have a bad experience; to suffer; to go through something unpleasant

definitions.gloss: to have a bad experience; to suffer; to go through something unpleasant
definitions.explanation: To experience something negative or unpleasant, often something one did not expect or deserve. Almost always used with a negative modifier describing the type of hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{目|め}に{遭|あ}った。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}{先|さき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦とんでもない→とんでもない：03470_tondemonai⟧{目|め}に{遭|あ}った。
examples.english: I had an awful experience at my travel destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}って→遭う：09500_au⟧、⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧な{目|め}に{遭|あ}った⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気|き}をつけよう→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: After hearing the story of someone who was scammed and went through a terrible ordeal, I decided to be more careful myself.

notes:
The core expression is 〜{目|め}に{遭|あ}う, where ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ means "experience" and ⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧ means "to encounter." It is almost exclusively used for negative experiences. The type of bad experience is specified by a modifier before ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{目|め}に{遭|あ}う: to have a terrible experience
- ⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧な{目|め}に{遭|あ}う: to go through a miserable ordeal
- ⟦とんでもない→とんでもない：03470_tondemonai⟧{目|め}に{遭|あ}う: to have an outrageous experience
- ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧{目|め}に{遭|あ}う: to have a frightening experience
- ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧{目|め}に{遭|あ}う: to suffer painful consequences

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目|め}に{遭|あ}わせる: to put someone through a bad experience — the causative form, meaning to inflict hardship on someone
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to suffer damage; to be victimized — more formal, emphasizes concrete harm
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}する→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧: to struggle; to have a hard time — emphasizes prolonged effort rather than a discrete bad event
